name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Jama Connect's whole value proposition is turning complex, cross-functional engineering work into something traceable and accurate. A deal desk does the same job on the commercial side: taking a renewal, an upsell, or a multidate co-term scenario and turning it into a quote that's accurate, approved, and ready to book. I've spent 15+ years on the sales side of that handoff, and I'm ready to move to the side that builds it.

At Accelo, I sold and scoped the company's own CRM/PSA platform to agencies and professional-services firms, then tracked my own bookings and commission tiers closely enough to hit accelerator tiers consistently (roughly $213K annualized in implementation and services bookings). At Birdeye, I managed a network of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes from $10K to $45K, coordinating with Product and Engineering to keep partner data and feedback accurate. Across Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Accelo, I've built the CRM hygiene and data-accuracy habits a deal desk depends on, not just used the tools.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience maps to Jama's quoting process. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
